ir.name: ref_all_pairs_builder
ir.intuition: Reference builder: all winner/loser pairs by objective ordering.

ir.name: loss_logsigmoid_inverse_advantage_diff
ir.intuition: Shift from multiplicative or margin-based losses to an inverse advantage difference weighting paradigm using a logsigmoid link on the difference of log probabilities scaled inversely by the clipped absolute advantage gap, stabilizing learning by down-weighting pairs with large advantage gaps and focusing on ambiguous pairs.
ir.pseudocode:
adv_gap_abs = clamp(abs(advantage_w - advantage_l), min_clip, max_clip)
inv_adv_scale = 1.0 / adv_gap_abs
norm_diff = (log_prob_w - log_prob_l) * inv_adv_scale
x = clamp(norm_diff, -20, 20)
loss = -logsigmoid(x) * weight
return mean(loss)
ir.code:
def generated_loss(batch, model_output, extra):
    lpw = batch['log_prob_w']
    lpl = batch['log_prob_l']
    weight = batch.get('weight', None)
    adv_w = batch['advantage_w']
    adv_l = batch['advantage_l']
    eps = 1e-4
    max_clip = 10.0
    # Compute absolute advantage difference and clip
    adv_gap = ops.abs(ops.sub(adv_w, adv_l))
    adv_gap_clipped = ops.clamp(adv_gap, eps, max_clip)
    inv_adv_scale = ops.div(ops.ones_like(adv_gap_clipped), adv_gap_clipped)
    # Compute scaled difference of log probabilities
    diff = ops.sub(lpw, lpl)
    scaled_diff = ops.mul(diff, inv_adv_scale)
    # Clamp to avoid numerical issues
    x = ops.clamp(scaled_diff, -20.0, 20.0)
    loss = ops.neg(ops.logsigmoid(x))
    if weight is not None:
        loss = ops.mul(loss, weight)
    return ops.mean(loss)
